Federal Reserve raises benchmark interest rate for first time since 2023
India cabinet clears proposal to raise EPF wage ceiling to ₹25,000

Madurai Meenakshi Temple holds kumbabishekam ceremony after 17 years

articles.headline: US House Passes Russia Sanctions Bill With Tariffs
articles.whyItMatters: Could impose up to 100% tariffs on major Russian oil buyers like India.
articles.brief: The US House passed a sweeping Russia sanctions bill empowering the president to levy up to 100% tariffs on top purchasers of Russian energy, raising trade tensions for India.

articles.headline: Federal Reserve Raises Interest Rates First Time Since 2023
articles.whyItMatters: Signals a major shift in monetary policy amid persistent global inflation.
articles.brief: The US Federal Reserve increased its benchmark interest rate to combat inflation, drawing immediate criticism from President Trump who demanded sharply lower borrowing costs.

articles.headline: India Cabinet Clears EPF Wage Limit Hike
articles.whyItMatters: Expands formal social security net coverage for millions of organized workers.
articles.brief: The Indian cabinet has cleared a proposal to raise the Employees' Provident Fund wage upper limit to 25,000 rupees, benefiting a broader segment of formal salaried employees.

articles.headline: India Considers Vegetable Oil Import Tax Cuts
articles.whyItMatters: Aims to cool down climbing domestic food prices and manage inflation.
articles.brief: Amid rising global prices, the Indian government is actively considering cuts to vegetable oil import taxes to provide relief to domestic consumers and stabilize markets.

articles.headline: UPI Fee Shake-Up Prompts Cost Reassessment
articles.whyItMatters: Restructures merchant onboarding economics and banking returns across digital payments.
articles.brief: The recent changes to UPI fee structures and zero-MDR models have forced merchants and digital brands to recalculate processing costs as transaction volumes surge nationwide.

articles.headline: Australia Bars Foreign Students From Bringing Dependents
articles.whyItMatters: Tightens immigration policies significantly, impacting international student enrollment numbers.
articles.brief: Australia has introduced strict regulations barring foreign students from bringing partners and children while they pursue their studies, reshaping international education dynamics.

articles.headline: Banks Fund $22 Billion AI Cloud Chip Venture
articles.whyItMatters: Demonstrates massive capital mobilization for global artificial intelligence infrastructure expansion.
articles.brief: A syndicate of major banks has provided a $22 billion loan to finance a chip and AI cloud computing venture led by Blackstone and Alphabet, sources report.

articles.headline: Maratha Activist Manoj Jarange Ends 20-Day Fast
articles.whyItMatters: Eases political tensions in Maharashtra by granting a three-month ultimatum.
articles.brief: Maratha reservation activist Manoj Jarange called off his 20-day fast after holding discussions with a government delegation, giving authorities a three-month deadline to fulfill demands.

articles.headline: Arjun Erigaisi Suffers Upset Defeat at Chess Olympiad
articles.whyItMatters: Marks a surprising start for India's top-tier players in the international tournament.
articles.brief: India's second-ranked chess player Arjun Erigaisi suffered an unexpected Round 1 upset against a lower-rated opponent at the Chess Olympiad, though the wider national team secured wins.

articles.headline: Madurai Meenakshi Temple Holds Kumbabishekam After 17 Years
articles.whyItMatters: A massive cultural and religious milestone drawing lakhs of devotees to Tamil Nadu.
articles.brief: Lakhs of devotees gathered in Madurai to witness the grand consecration ceremony of the historic Meenakshi Sundareswarar temple, held after a gap of 17 years under tight security.

articles.headline: US Officials Meet Iran-Backed Houthis in Oman
articles.whyItMatters: Efforts intensify to de-escalate maritime conflicts and secure trade routes in the region.
articles.brief: US officials held direct talks over the weekend with Iran-backed Houthi representatives in Oman, running parallel to diplomatic efforts to wind down active conflicts in the Middle East.

articles.headline: Sri Lanka Batter Silva to Miss Asian Games
articles.whyItMatters: Weakens Sri Lanka's squad following a strong performance at the Women's Asia Cup.
articles.brief: Sri Lanka middle-order batter Silva has been ruled out of the upcoming Asian Games due to a finger injury sustained during their recent tournament run.
